In controllable data-to-text natural language generation (henceforth data2text), tabular data is transformed into surface text that structures, relates and verbalizes the relevant pieces of information as close as possible to the domain-specific characteristic features and structures of the corresponding text types.

guideline: participants were asked to estimate lower and upper thresholds for numerical features such that the resulting interval of values agrees to their expectations the expression raises; they adjusted thresholds in comparison to choices for other items on the page.
